# Version 4.156.0 (Unreleased)
> **Path and glyph rendering reliability**

## Highlights

Upcoming m156 fixes improve clipped paths, glyph replay and Graphite readback. These native-engine corrections leave the managed API unchanged.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Bug Fixes

- **Clipped path rendering** — Corrects Ganesh device-space path bounds and software coverage-mask clamping, plus Graphite clip keys and wedge miter bounds. Fixes convex anti-aliased rasterization buffer overflows and fixed-point overflow for edges far outside the clip, except when built with SK_LEGACY_ALPHA_RUNS. ([#5617](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5617), [#5631](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5631))
- **Validated glyph replay** — Validates serialized Slug positions, matrices, bounds and flags, bounds direct-mask offsets, and preserves creation-time rounding during replay. Retains rendering fallbacks for unsuitable glyph data and handles replay when glyph-atlas bilinear filtering is unavailable. ([#5617](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5617), [#5624](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5624))
- **Graphite alpha-to-RGBx readback** — Corrects GPU-to-CPU transfer pixel sizing when reading alpha textures into RGBx destinations, ensuring every destination pixel bit is written. ([#5631](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5631))
